title: Monday Night Burrito Bowl Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
blurb:
Set sail on Lake Minnetonka for a delightful 2-hour cruise while crafting your own burrito bowl. Enjoy a unique dining experience aboard a two-story yacht as you glide past the scenic beauty of Big Island, featuring stunning homes, parks, and marinas. Customize your bowl with fresh ingredients like pulled pork, chicken, salsa, and guacamole. This family-friendly cruise is perfect for ages 2 and up, with drinks available for purchase. Relax and soak in the sights while savoring a delicious meal in a vibrant atmosphere.

- Two-hour scenic cruise around Big Island on Lake Minnetonka
- Build your own burrito bowl with a variety of delicious toppings
- Family-friendly, catering to adults and children alike
- Drinks available for purchase, enhancing the cruise experience
